scope: Robot supplemental experiments, not human playtests or the main A/B matrix.
common: Same seeds across groups/moves; 720x1560; firstRun=true; xianxia; 60Hz; no HP reset, reroll, injected card, speedup or runtime mutation.
wanjian: Unmodified makePicker(prefer:wanjian): evolution first, then existing preference ranking.
max_meta: Unmodified makePicker(prefer:spore_shot); defaultProfile funded to CRYSTAL_CAP, then Meta.buy until Meta.nextPrice is null for each real PERMANENT entry; use Meta.bonuses.

active_pills.base: Evolution always first. Eligible pills outrank ordinary upgrades: body > power > wind. Otherwise use makePicker(prefer:spore_shot) on non-pill cards, retaining original indices.
active_pills.refresh: Only eligible when same pill remaining <= 3 simulation seconds.
active_pills.body: HP <= 55% and danger: >=3 living enemies within center distance 200, >=2 approaching bubbles within 180, or a charging/windup Boss within 240.
active_pills.power: Living Boss within 650 OR >=8 living enemies within center distance 360.
active_pills.wind: XP currently outside pickup radius >= 2 * progression.needed, OR HP <=35% and the same danger criterion.
active_pills.ties: First eligible card in original offer order within the fixed body/power/wind priority.

coverage: Before each real step, test endTick > next simulation tick (expiry occurs at step start). Combat denominator counts steps starting in playing; Boss denominator additionally requires living Boss. Total-simulation coverage includes cleansing/extract. Paused/levelup choices contribute no ticks.
limits: Three supplementary groups are not a single-factor causal comparison. Flee/spore are bot algorithms, not measured human skill. Victory duration excludes losses/timeouts. Sample maxima/zero drops do not prove device performance or universal safety.
